inputMapping.source: the frozen Phase-C quartic three-envelope model
inputMapping.claim: the extension is a case assumption and not a derivation from the source paper

hypotheses.primaryAlternative: at least one non-control scenario passes stationarity, nontriviality, intrinsic localization, real-amplitude stability, phase stability, and the complete declared dynamic bank
hypotheses.primaryNull: no non-control scenario passes every declared necessary gate
hypotheses.outcomePolicy: report positive, negative, mixed, or numerically indeterminate without adding scenarios after inspection

preregistration.stoppingRule: evaluate exactly the six scenarios and four perturbations below once; do not expand the grid or remove a direction after inspecting results

scope.domain: one-dimensional finite interval [-L,L] with homogeneous Dirichlet boundaries
scope.staticPerturbationPolicy: block-LDL positive-definiteness certificates for complete real-amplitude and imaginary phase sectors on the fine grid
scope.dynamicPerturbationPolicy: paired-control complex velocity-Verlet evolution for every preregistered direction at base, time-refined, and space-refined resolution
